notes.title: Update notes for 2024-12-03
notes.notes:
Fix not being able to end a wave when a powerup/enemy leaves the playable area
Remember window size on restart (when in Windowed mode)

notes.title: Update notes for 2024-12-02
notes.notes:
Reduced CRT filter intensity
Added wave limit option when starting new game
Added numpad support

notes.title: Update notes for 2024-11-29
notes.notes:
Two new enemy types!
Slow down time when city is damaged
Health bars added to things below 100%
Make damage flash slower when high damage is taken

notes.title: Update notes for 2024-11-28
notes.notes:
New double-barrel sprite for Impact Artillery
Make CRT filter more consistent across different resolutions
Add sounds when navigating menus
Increased spawn rate
Decreased enemy speed
Add flash when things take damage

notes.title: Update notes for 2024-11-22
notes.notes:
Made fullscreen on by default
Improved contrast on buttons in menu
Added artillery type to gameover screen
Headers are now text pixelated with a shader instead of static images
Increased explosive artillery shell TTL to 7.5 seconds
New power-up toast messages
Added left/right select elements for some menu items
